messages:
maya: quick kickoff — Q3 onramp decisions. need SKU profiles + SLA tradeoffs by EOD Tue so product can lock launch criteria.
kevin: copy. what's the baseline ask from product? are we prioritizing latency or cost for the first wave?
sara: product asked for 99th p50 latency target <120ms for hosted API in eu-west and ap-southeast for top-tier customers. they also want predictable monthly cost per tenant.
nate: that 120ms is tight if we push h100-only in eu. we can hit it with dedicated reserved h100s but cost delta vs h100-mixed is ~2.3x.
olivia: finance-ops can accept a temporary premium if it's customer-driven, but need clear rollback triggers and a commit window.
finance-ops: can do a 3-month premium allocation but need expected qps and forecasted token burn numbers for each SKU. send a short table.
maya: agreed. i'll post conservative qps/tokens. we should define 3 SKU profiles: sparrow (low-cost burst), kestrel (balanced), hawk (low-latency reserved).
kevin: +1. propose config snippets below for onramp mapping (names are placeholders):
```
profiles:
  - name: sparrow
    capacity_type: spot-mixed
    target_latency_p50: 250ms
    target_latency_p99: 900ms
    cost_multiplier: 0.6
  - name: kestrel
    capacity_type: reserved-hybrid
    target_latency_p50: 140ms
    target_latency_p99: 300ms
    cost_multiplier: 1.0
  - name: hawk
    capacity_type: reserved-dedicated
    target_latency_p50: 90ms
    target_latency_p99: 120ms
    cost_multiplier: 2.3
```
nate: baseline questions: 1) can we route by customer tier across regions? 2) what's fallback if hawk capacity exhausted?
sara: 1) yes — smart routing layer can pin by tenant. 2) fallback should go to kestrel in same region, then kestrel in next nearest region, then sparrow as last resort. product wants graceful degradation not hard failures.
olivia: region expansion note — ap-southeast likely needs a small footprint (2-3 GPUs) initially. that will force hawk into hybrid reserved with cross-region fallback.
kevin: ops impact — hybrid reserved means we need cross-zone KV cache sync plan. that adds ~30% complexity/time for rollout. call this out as launch criterion.
maya: noted. launch criteria draft: 1) hawk P99 < 130ms in-staging for 48h, 2) cross-region fallback latency < +80ms tail, 3) finance sign-off on 90-day premium, 4) runbook & autoscale policy tested for eviction scenarios.
devops-bot: Reminder: procurement doc updated — https://redwood.internal/docs/procurement/onramp-profiles (edited).
finance-ops: please add the three-month spend forecast per profile by tomorrow noon or we can't approve. include token assumptions.
sara: i'll attach a conservative forecast and perf numbers from the beta tests.
kevin: also adding a short risk table:
- risk: spot eviction in apac -> mitigation: pre-warmed reserved burst pool and instant fallback to kestrel
- risk: KV cache miss cross-region -> mitigation: prefix caching + warmup bufs
- risk: cost overrun -> mitigation: automated throttle + finance alert at 70% burn
maya: next steps: kevin + sara to finalize profile configs and perf numbers; nate to scope KV sync work + estimate rollout lift; olivia/finance to confirm 90-day premium window. sync in 24h.
olivia: i'll block time for a 30m decision meeting tomorrow 11am PT. pls add calendar invite. :calendar:
